event.summary: Ordinary Recent host-loss concern retains checked installation fences
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 350a4b33b6d4476f4a78e43cea124bc2b828f462. TLDR: the original concern is that an ordinary Recent clears a previously chosen host on leaving environment mode and could reuse its folder on a fallback host. That mutation is real: accept_recent and search Recent clear chosen_host when target Some becomes None (draft.rs:2017-2021 and 2826-2831). Source guards, retained for independent checking rather than treating the parent's drops as accepted: in ordinary Create, selected becomes None while recipe is Some (create_form.rs:3657-3663), so ordinary offers disappear through offered_recent_history's two-installation equality check (1478-1490). A retained ordinary callback refuses unless its nonempty captured target equals live_destination: 'if expected.is_none() || expected.as_ref() != live.peek().as_ref() { return false; }' (1697-1708). Successful admission stores that captured target in remembered_destination (1709). In the pre-render gap, selected_now is recomputed from live chosen_host at submit (6179-6184), and target_matches_selection rejects the fallback until the parent create_target matches it (6207-6214). After a render changes live_destination, remembered_destination_matches rejects remembered Some(old) against the fallback (1684-1689, 6190-6195); the same remembered check runs again after key minting (7000-7010). Existing host defaults cannot override an explicit Recent folder: seed_default_folder requires !folder_is_explicit (draft.rs:1707-1711). Replace with differs from Create: host_fixed keeps its ordinary offers available even after the mistaken environment Recent in l2; an ordinary Recent can clear that target, but its lost chosen_host is not automatically rebound (resolve_clone_host, create_form.rs:2657-2667). If fallback differs from source, replacement has the additional prefill.host != selected_now refusal (6356-6383). Original suspected consequence preserved: a remembered folder could launch on another host. Source analysis establishes blocked or conditional recovery, not that wrong-host launch. Suggested bucket: other; confidence: confirmed mutation and source guards, no demonstrated bypass. proposed_drop: ordinary offers/callback admission plus synchronous target matching and remembered-install checks prevent the suspected wrong-host execution; this remains a proposed disposition for the caller's independent check. Exact governing contract: SPEC.md Creation says 'A recent row fills every saved choice and destination' and 'A retargeted registry row cannot expose the replaced install’s history' (the implementation uses the recorded install boundary described there). possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route; a source-deletion or cross-host dispatch bypass would be needed to raise that impact and none was found. No execution or reproduction performed.
